content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; the necessity appeal has already been attempted, so no compliant payer rework remains. There is no adjudicated deductible or coinsurance liability showing that the patient properly owes this authorization denial, so billing the full balance would exceed established contractual patient responsibility.","action":"write_off"}
